evidence.excerpt: Boris Rakić received his B.Sc. in Computer Science from the University of Novi Sad in 2011 and his M.Sc. in Bioinformatics from the same institution in 2014. He completed his Ph.D. at the University of Novi Sad in 2019, with a thesis on parallelising short-read alignment algorithms for shared-memory architectures. Since 2020 he has been a Research Associate in the Data Science and Bioinformatics Group at BioSense Institute, where the group develops scalable data pipelines for precision agriculture and clinical genomics. He contributes to teaching a graduate-level course on biological data analysis. He works primarily with the group's on-premises HPC cluster and has hands-on experience with AWS and Google Cloud genomics environments.
